validation: Checked with the structural catalogue gate and deterministic re-authoring. The bundled template passes the bundled checker, bpmnlint 11.15.0 (recommended rules) and bpmn-moddle with zero findings; the checker caught all 15 seeded defects on mutated copies (8 errors, 7 warnings, including 6 style rules). Lucidchart import was not exercised. Behavioural benchmarking against a no-skill baseline is outstanding.
sources: XML structure from the OMG BPMN 2.0.2 specification and its published XSD namespaces. Style warnings in the bundled checker implement rules from Bruce Silver's published Method and Style rules, eCH-0158 v1.2 and Seven Process Modeling Guidelines (2010). Lint rule names refer to the bpmnlint tool, which is used, not copied. The bundled checker script and template are original.
